final: WITH per_customer AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM Orders GROUP BY customer_id), total AS (SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total_orders FROM per_customer) SELECT p.customer_id, p.order_count, CAST(p.order_count AS REAL) / t.total_orders FROM per_customer AS p CROSS JOIN total AS t ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
